an4.159:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Ānando Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
an4.159:1.3: Atha kho aññatarā bhikkhunī aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:
an4.159:1.4: Ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa yen' ayyo Ānando ten' upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena ayyassa Ānandassa pāde sirasā vanda:
an4.159:1.5: itthannāmā bhante bhikkhunī ābādhikinī dukkhitā bāḷhagilānā
an4.159:1.6: ayyassa Ānandassa pāde sirasā vandatīti. Evañ ca vadehi--sādhu
an4.159:1.7: kira bhante ayyo Ānando yena bhikkhunīpassayo yena sā bhikkhunī ten' upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
an4.159:1.8: Evam ayye ti kho so puriso tassā bhikkhuniyā paṭisutvā yen' āyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca :
an4.159:2.1: Itthannāmā bhante bhikkhunī ābādhikinī dukkhitā bāḷhagilānā
an4.159:2.2: ayyassa Ānandassa pāde sirasā vandati, evañ ca vadeti:
an4.159:2.3: sādhu kira bhante āyasmā Ānando yena bhikkhunipassayo yena sā bhikkhunī ten' upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
an4.159:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena bhikkhunipassayo ten' upasaṅkami.
an4.159:3.2: Addasā kho sā bhikkhunī āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ
an4.159:3.3: disvā sā sīsaṃ pārupitvā mañcake nipajji.
an4.159:3.4: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena sā bhikkhunī ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho āyasmā Ānando taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad avoca : 3.
an4.159:4.1: Āhārasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo āhāraṃ nissāya
an4.159:4.3: taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo taṇhaṃ nissāya
an4.159:4.5: mānasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo mānaṃ nissāya
an4.159:5.1: Āhārasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo āhāraṃ nissāya
an4.159:5.2: āhāro pahātabbo ti--iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ
an4.159:5.4: Idha bhagini bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti
an4.159:5.5: n' eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvad eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya. Iti purāṇañ ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañ ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
an4.159:5.6: So aparena samayena āhāraṃ nissāya āharaṃ pajahati.
an4.159:5.7: Āhārasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo āhāraṃ nissāya āhāro pahātabbo
an4.159:5.8: ti--iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 5.
an4.159:6.1: Taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo taṇhaṃ nissāya
an4.159:6.2: taṇhā pahātabbā ti--iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ
an4.159:6.5: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
an4.159:6.7: kudassu nāma aham pi āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissāmīti.
an4.159:6.8: So aparena samayena taṇhaṃ nissāya taṇhaṃ pajahati.
an4.159:6.9: Taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo taṇhaṃ nissāya taṇhā pahātabbā
an4.159:6.10: ti--iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 6.
an4.159:7.1: Mānasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo mānaṃ nissāya
an4.159:7.2: māno pahātabbo ti--iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ
an4.159:7.5: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
an4.159:7.7: so hi nāma āyasmā āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati,
an4.159:7.9: So aparena samayena mānaṃ nissāya mānaṃ pajahati.
an4.159:7.10: Mānasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo mānaṃ nissāya māno pahātabbo
an4.159:7.11: ti--iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 7.
an4.159:8.2: methuno ca setughāto vutto Bhagavatā ti. 8.
an4.159:9.1: Atha kho sā bhikkhunī mañcakā vuṭṭhahitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā āyasmato Ānandassa pādesu sirasā nipatitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca :
an4.159:9.2: Accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathā-akusalaṃ sāhaṃ evam akāsiṃ.
an4.159:9.3: Tassā me bhante ayyo Ānando accayaṃ accayato paṭigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyāti. 9.
an4.159:9.4: Taggha tvaṃ bhagini accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathā-akusalaṃ yā tvaṃ evam akāsi.
an4.159:9.5: Yato ca kho tvaṃ bhagini accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi tan te mayaṃ paṭigaṇhāma.
an4.159:9.6: Vuddhi h' esā bhagini ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ apajjatīti. 160. 1.
